recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat UP-792 or any successor ResearchStudyPurposeType terminology work as a separate BRR/UTG change rather than as part of FHIR-14287.
issue_request: FHIR-14287 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 BRR request to remove bio-banking and epidemiologic from the ResearchStudyPrimaryPurposeType value set because those values were not in the original vetted list.
initial_application: Historical commit f09300abf4272bd789b4f6fd15f5fed283c7d38e explicitly referenced #14287 and removed the epidemiological and bio-banking rows from source/researchstudy/researchstudy-spreadsheet.xml and from the ResearchStudy primary-purpose short list.
additional_context: Current ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini and now exposes ResearchStudy.purposeType with bindingName ResearchStudyPrimaryPurposeType, bound to the THO value set http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/research-study-prim-purp-type. Later BRR work changed binding/name context and is developing a future replacement terminology, but current THO version 2.0.0 and the future proposal do not restore the two removed legacy codes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because ResearchStudy source has no removed-code references and the active THO CodeSystem contains only treatment, prevention, diagnostic, supportive-care, screening, health-services-research, basic-science, and device-feasibility.

related_jiras.note: Added the ResearchStudy.primaryPurposeType value set that FHIR-14287 immediately narrowed.
Changed the binding-strength discussion for the same element without restoring bio-banking or epidemiologic.
Moved ResearchStudy bindings, including research-study-prim-purp-type, to THO.
Renamed ResearchStudy.primaryPurposeType to ResearchStudy.purposeType and left a temporary binding path while a new terminology is developed.
Pending UTG proposal for a new ResearchStudyPurposeType CodeSystem/ValueSet; outside this core reconciliation and not a restoration of the removed legacy codes.
